summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a 6-K announcing an A$20.7 million institutional placement and a non-underwritten share purchase plan (SPP) targeting up to A$3.0 million. The offer price is A$0.16 per share, representing a 33.3% discount to the last traded price of A$0.24 and a 31.2% discount to the 5-day VWAP of A$0.23. Proceeds will fund capital expenditure for production capacity. The SPP is contingent on ASX waivers for discount rules; if waived, no shareholder approval is needed. This equity raising dilutes existing shareholders, and the trading halt preceded the announcement. Watch for SPP uptake and ASX waiver decisions.
